cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_DOWNLO: The TeraBox download server did not recognize the current authorization (HTTP 403, upstream 31045: user not exists). This does not establish that the share expired or the account does not exist. Check tool compatibility and authorization, and resolve the download rejection before continuing.
The TeraBox download server denied access (HTTP 403) without a recognized specific reason. The share may still be browsable; check download access in the official client before continuing.
cloudDownload.title: Cloud drive download
cloudDownload.description: Recognize Baidu Netdisk, Google Drive and GoFile shares, transfer through a workflow and add tasks to the download center. Other sources wait for attention.
cloudDownload.started: Workflow #{{id}} created. Open its details to handle accounts, dependencies and source selection.
cloudDownload.chooseHint: Choose the content to download. Select one mirror within a group. Review ungrouped links individually; they are never all selected automatically.
cloudDownload.workflow.label: Download workflow
cloudDownload.workflow.loadFailed: Unable to load workflows. Please retry.
cloudDownload.account.label: Baidu Netdisk account
cloudDownload.account.selectionHint: Used for Baidu transfers and downloads. Other providers ignore this setting. Manage credentials in third-party settings.
cloudDownload.account.loadFailed: Unable to load accounts. Check third-party settings and retry.
cloudDownload.account.description: Manage BaiduPCS-Go accounts. Import Baidu credentials to validate login. Credentials stay on the server; logging out clears the local credentials.
cloudDownload.account.name: Account name
cloudDownload.account.stoken: Share transfers require the Netdisk STOKEN. Provide it together with BDUSS.
cloudDownload.downloadLayout.label: Local output
cloudDownload.downloadLayout.description: Only local output is affected; original source folders are always preserved.
cloudDownload.allowUngrouped: Automatically select ungrouped sources (enable only when each URL is separate content)
cloudDownload.resume.description: Select sources and provide any missing account, dependency or directory, then continue. Each content target uses one mirror.
cloudDownload.resume.keepDirectory: Leave empty to keep the workflow’s existing directory.
cloudDownload.trigger.name: Download sources submitted
cloudDownload.trigger.description: Starts when sources are submitted from the download center or saved post results. Input includes content groups, candidate URLs, access codes and output directory. Finishing post parsing does not invoke this entry automatically.
cloudDownload.activity.download.prepareS: Build a source workset from post results, keeping content groups and extraction information.
cloudDownload.activity.download.selectSo: Select a source for each content target. Automatic selection uses provider priority and can explicitly include ungrouped sources.
cloudDownload.activity.baidu.transfer.de: Transfer selected Baidu shares into the account and persist remote receipts for later downloads.
cloudDownload.activity.baidu.download.de: Create download-center tasks for remote entries or transfer receipts. Shares need a preceding transfer step.
cloudDownload.activity.download.enqueueS: Route selected sources to download-center tasks. Baidu shares require a preceding transfer. Unsupported sources or missing configuration wait for attention.
cloudDownload.activity.download.awaitCom: Wait for associated tasks and retain downloaded files for each content target. Failed tasks can be fixed before continuing.
cloudDownload.recipe.name: Download selected sources
workflow.activity.cloudPrepare.descripti: Build a source workset from post results, keeping content groups and extraction information.
workflow.activity.cloudSelect.descriptio: Select a source for each content target. Automatic selection uses provider priority and can explicitly include ungrouped sources.
workflow.activity.baiduTransfer.descript: Transfer selected Baidu shares into the account and persist remote receipts for later downloads.
workflow.activity.baiduDownload.descript: Create download-center tasks for remote entries or transfer receipts. Shares need a preceding transfer step.
workflow.activity.cloudEnqueue.descripti: Route selected sources to download-center tasks. Baidu shares require a preceding transfer. Unsupported sources or missing configuration wait for attention.
workflow.activity.cloudAwait.description: Wait for associated tasks and retain downloaded files for each content target. Failed tasks can be fixed before continuing.
cloudDownload.account.cookieHint: Use the Cookie from the Baidu Netdisk website; both BDUSS and STOKEN are required.
workflow.waitReason.cloud.cloudAttention: Resolve an account, dependency or failed task
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_LOGIN_REQUIR: Select and log in to a Baidu account.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_CREDENTIALS_: Invalid Baidu credentials. Import them again.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_SESSION_EXPI: The Baidu session expired. Log in again.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_ACCOUNT_NOT_: The account was deleted. Select another account.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_ACCOUNT_MISM: This operation is bound to another Baidu account. Continue with the original account.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_ACCOUNT_IDEN: These credentials belong to another Baidu identity. Add a separate account.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_TRANSFER_REQ: Transfer the share with the Baidu transfer node first.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_BRIDGE_START: Unable to start the Baidu tool. Check its installation.
cloudDownload.validation.directory: Set an absolute local download directory.
cloudDownload.http: Direct file URL (confirm that this URL returns a file)
cloudDownload.activity.download.processF: Process each resource's exact downloaded files using its saved instructions and archive password. Originals are retained. Missing instructions or passwords wait for input. No resource is created; results are stored in the current server's data directory.
workflow.activity.cloudProcessFiles.desc: Process each resource's exact file manifest with its saved extraction instructions. Keep original downloads and wait for missing instructions or passwords.
cloudDownload.processing.resumeHint: Only this content target is processed. Input files and completed sibling results are retained.
cloudDownload.processing.directoryAtExec: Processed output directory at execution time
cloudDownload.results.historicalPaths: These paths were recorded during execution and may change after relocation or cleanup. See artifact details for current locations.
cloudDownload.reuse.description: Reuse known content only after verifying the local files against their saved SHA256 checksums. Unverified or changed files are fetched or processed again.
cloudDownload.reuse.processingHint: This option reruns processing. To download again, enable the corresponding option in the download node.
cloudDownload.processing.recursiveHint: Continue only with nested archives produced by explicitly approved extraction. Unselected original files remain intact. Originals are retained unless a separate cleanup node quarantines them.
cloudDownload.processing.recursivePasswo: A nested archive may need a different password. Your answer applies to the archive currently waiting; completed outputs are retained.
cloudDownload.processing.currentPassword: Provide the password for the current archive. It is used only for this waiting input; completed results are retained.
cloudDownload.processing.archiveInputHin: Review the archive selector and exact processing instructions. This run can only use its selected input manifest; acquire missing volumes separately. No file name or extension is guessed. Automatic detection has a bounded probe budget.
cloudDownload.processing.budgetExceeded: Extraction paused at a limit. Review the limits or free disk space, then continue. The target is not marked complete while archives remain unresolved.
cloudDownload.processing.repeatedContent: Repeated archive content was found. Extraction is paused to prevent an archive loop; review the archive and processing instructions.
cloudDownload.processing.waitingShared: Another workflow is processing the same input. Check again after it commits its result to reuse it without duplicate processing.
cloudDownload.activity.download.cleanupA: Keeps originals by default. The policy may quarantine them, or delete them after final delivery and per-file retention or replacement are verified. Unknown files and files still in use are kept.
Keep original files, or move verified, unused original file groups into recoverable quarantine after processing succeeds.
workflow.waitReason.cloud.cleanupArtifac: Wait for file cleanup to become safe
cloudDownload.cleanup.quarantine: Move original files into recoverable quarantine
cloudDownload.cleanup.safetyHint: Cleanup is a separate step. The system checks each file’s retained copy or replacement; a successful step or model judgment alone cannot authorize deletion. Missing evidence, shared use or changed files prevent cleanup. Delivered files are unaffected.
cloudDownload.cleanup.waitingHint: Cleanup waits until the original file group can be moved safely. Original files and successful processing outputs are retained. Check again after other consumers finish.
cloudDownload.cleanup.restoreFailed: Unable to restore the files. Check the original paths and retry.
cloudDownload.cleanup.status.quarantined: Original files are in recoverable quarantine
cloudDownload.cleanup.status.failed: Cleanup failed; processing results are retained
workflow.activity.fsProcessArtifacts.des: Process exact local files with saved instructions, verified artifact reuse and optional recursive extraction. Missing instructions or passwords wait for input. No resource is created and originals are retained.
workflow.activity.fsPublishArtifacts.des: Copy an exact verified manifest into a user directory, preserve shared originals and verify the delivery. Pause on conflicting files without overwriting them. Verified deliveries can satisfy later runs.
cloudDownload.publication.defaultDirecto: Use a separate result directory under this download location
cloudDownload.publication.directoryHint: Cloud downloads use a stable source directory when left blank, or separate subdirectories for multiple targets. Acquisition uses its configured destination. Delivery must be outside application data.
cloudDownload.publication.conflictHint: Existing files are never overwritten. Choose another directory, or resolve the conflict and retry. Shared originals and completed copies remain available.
cloudDownload.processing.policy.instruct: Follow explicit instructions; ask when instructions are missing
cloudDownload.processing.policy.autoDete: Approve automatic detection and extraction of initial archives
cloudDownload.processing.policy.keep: Keep files without extraction or renaming
cloudDownload.processing.authorizationHi: The recursive switch only controls inner layers after extraction has been approved. It never approves unknown or missing instructions.
cloudDownload.processing.policyScopeHint: Choosing automatic detection or keeping files here authorizes this processing request. Future requests using the default instruction policy do not inherit that choice. Verified results from explicitly confirmed instructions can be reused for the same request.
cloudDownload.activity.acquisition.fetch: Use the shared source adapters and download center, then pass the exact file manifest to processing and library delivery.
cloudDownload.source.googleDrive.descrip: Download public files and folders. Private account files and native Google document exports are not supported.
cloudDownload.source.gofile.description: Download public files and folders. Enter an access password when creating the download if required.
cloudDownload.source.pixeldrain.descript: Public /u files and /l lists use gallery-dl; Filesystem /d directories use rclone. Dependencies are specific to the selected method.
cloudDownload.source.pikpak.description: The official PikPak CLI saves public shares to an authorized account and downloads original files. Existing account files and folders can still use rclone. A visible share does not guarantee anonymous access to its original files.
cloudDownload.source.oneDrive.descriptio: Public SharePoint folders can be downloaded directly; account paths use rclone OAuth. The two methods have different input scopes and account requirements.
cloudDownload.source.baidu.description: Use a signed-in account to receive shares or download files and folders from the account.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_ORIGINA: PikPak can display this share but did not provide an anonymous original-file URL. Connect a PikPak account in third-party settings, then use Diagnose and continue. This does not mean the share is expired.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_PUBLIC_: PikPak rejected anonymous access and may require sign-in or verification. Check the share in the official client.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_VERIFIC: Interactive verification is required. Complete it in the official client or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_ACCESS_: This share needs a valid access code. Check the source information and retry.
cloudDownload.problemCode.SHAREPOINT_PUB: This folder does not allow anonymous downloading. Sign-in, an invitation or a password may be required. Obtain the files manually before continuing.
cloudDownload.problemCode.SHAREPOINT_PAS: This method does not support SharePoint password or sign-in verification. Obtain the files manually before continuing.
cloudDownload.problemCode.SOURCE_NETWORK: DNS cannot provide a verifiable public address. Configure an explicit proxy for this source or the source-link resolver, then retry.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIXELDRAIN_SHA: This Pixeldrain share has expired, been removed, or is unavailable. Choose another source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.CLOUD_PARTIAL_: The partial file could not be matched to the source and the original download manifest. Check the original folder and source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.CLOUD_RANGE_UN: The source did not return the requested range of original bytes. The partial file was retained. Resume the original download when the source supports byte ranges.
cloudDownload.problemCode.CLOUD_DOWNLOAD: The file checksum differs from the source. Bytes present before this attempt were retained. Check the file and source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIXELDRAIN_ACC: This Pixeldrain file requires access permission or a paid plan and cannot be downloaded through the public-share method.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIXELDRAIN_VER: Pixeldrain requires interactive verification. Use the official page or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIXELDRAIN_RAT: Pixeldrain is limiting requests or transfer quota. Try again later.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIXELDRAIN_NET: The public Pixeldrain file could not be read. Check the network and retry.
cloudDownload.problemCode.GOOGLE_DOWNLOA: Google Drive has reached this file's download quota. Try later or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.GOOGLE_DRIVE_S: This Google Drive share is unavailable or requires access permission. Check the share or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.GOFILE_SHARE_N: GoFile content could not be retrieved; expiry is not confirmed. Check the source again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.GOFILE_ACCESS_: This GoFile share requires access permission or verification. Check its access details before retrying.
cloudDownload.problemCode.CLOUD_NETWORK_: The download tool could not reach the source. Check its network settings and retry.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PUBLICATION_IO: File delivery encountered a read or write error. Check the storage device or network share. Downloaded and processed artifacts were retained; retry delivery once storage recovers.
cloudDownload.problemCode.CLOUD_RATE_LIM: The source is limiting requests or transfer quota. Try again later.
cloudDownload.problemCode.CLOUD_ACCESS_R: The source requires access permission or verification. Check the selected account and share access.
cloudDownload.problemCode.CLOUD_TOOL_FAI: The download tool failed. Check the source and tool status, then retry.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_SHARE_VE: Baidu could not verify this share. Check the share status and access details; this does not necessarily mean the access code is wrong.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_SHARE_CA: This Baidu Netdisk share has been cancelled. Provide a new valid share link or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_SHARE_EX: This Baidu Netdisk share has expired. Provide a new valid share link or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_SHARE_UN: This Baidu Netdisk share is currently unavailable; the cause has not been confirmed. Check its status and access conditions on the official page, or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_SHARE_PA: This address did not return a recognizable Baidu Netdisk share page. Check the complete share link or provide a new valid one.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_SHARE_AC: Baidu rejected the share access code. Check it and retry.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_SHARE_VE: Baidu requires interactive verification for this share. Complete verification on the official page before retrying, or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_SHARE_RE: Baidu returned a share response that could not be parsed. The share status is unknown. Check the official page or try again later.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_SHARE_NE: The Baidu share could not be reached or its response could not be read. Check the Baidu download tool's network settings and retry.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_ACCESS_C: Baidu rejected the share access code. Check it and retry.
rclone.account.label: rclone account
rclone.account.selectionHint: Select a configured account for this source. Access is checked again when downloading.
rclone.account.scope.pikpak: rclone uses this account to download existing account files and folders. Public-share saving and downloading use the separate official PikPak authorization above. Credentials are stored only on the current server.
rclone.account.scope.oneDrive: Authorize with native rclone OAuth and select a OneDrive or SharePoint site and drive. This method downloads paths inside the selected drive; arbitrary share links are not converted into account paths.
rclone.account.scope.pixeldrain: Configure Pixeldrain Filesystem credentials. Public files, lists and directories use their respective supported methods.
rclone.authorization.createHint: Save the account, then choose Authorize / reconnect. Saving alone does not start authorization or access the drive.
rclone.authorization.title: rclone authorization
rclone.authorization.remoteHint: This server uses headless authorization. Run this rclone command on a computer with a browser, sign in and approve access yourself, then paste the returned authorization result below. Keep that result private. Follow the subsequent site and drive prompts.
rclone.authorization.status.awaitingInpu: Waiting for your authorization or selection
rclone.account.rootFolderHint: Use me with an API key for your personal filesystem, or enter an accessible public directory ID. Download paths are relative to this root.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_ACCOUNT_NOT_CONFIG: Complete account credentials or authorization first.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: This account no longer exists. Select another account.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_ACCOUNT_INVALID: This account does not match the source. Select another account.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_ACCOUNT_VALIDATION: Connection validation failed. Check credentials, drive access and network settings.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_PATH_INVALID: Check the root or account path. Do not include a remote-name prefix or ...
rclone.problem.RCLONE_PIXELDRAIN_API_KEY: An API key is required for the personal me filesystem.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_ACCOUNT_CHANGED: The account configuration changed. Use the original configuration or create a new download.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_AUTHORIZATION_STAR: Unable to start authorization. Check the rclone installation and network settings, then retry.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_AUTHORIZATION_QUES: The authorization question changed. Refresh the status and answer the current question.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_AUTHORIZATION_RESU: The authorization result is invalid. Run the displayed command again and paste the complete result.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_ANSW: rclone did not accept this answer. Check it and try again.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_QUES: This authorization step is not supported. Check the rclone version or restart authorization.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_ANSW: Provide the information required by the current authorization question.
rclone.browser.introduction: Sign in to Microsoft and approve access in this browser, then return the callback URL to the server. You do not need to install rclone on this computer.
rclone.browser.openStep: 1. Open Microsoft sign-in and approve access
rclone.browser.callbackStep: 2. Copy the callback URL and paste it here
rclone.browser.callbackHint: After sign-in, the browser redirects to localhost:53682. With a remote server or Docker, a connection error is expected and does not mean Microsoft sign-in failed. Immediately copy the complete original URL, including every parameter after ?, return to this tab, paste it and submit. It contains one-time authorization information. Do not send it in chat or share it with anyone.
rclone.browser.callbackUrl: Complete callback URL after sign-in (sensitive, write-only)
rclone.browser.advanced: Advanced: authorize with a local rclone command
rclone.authorization.selectionHint: After authorization, choose the OneDrive drive or SharePoint site to use. This determines which files this account can access.
rclone.authorization.question.config_typ: Choose a drive or site type
rclone.authorization.questionHint.config: Choose the account's access root, not a destination for saving shared files. Only a server-verified accessible primary drive is shown first as My OneDrive. Inspect other candidates and preview their roots under Advanced.

Choose the account's access root, not a destination for saving shared files. Only a server-verified accessible primary drive is shown first as My OneDrive. Inspect other candidates and preview their roots under Advanced.
rclone.authorization.readOnlyScope: OAuth lets Bakabase read files this signed-in account already has permission to access, including permitted document libraries. It does not bypass sharing permissions.
rclone.authorization.accessRootHint: The drive sets the root for account downloads. It is not a destination for transferring shared files.
rclone.authorization.publicShareScope: If you only download supported public SharePoint shares, you can skip account authorization; the sharer does not need to authorize here either. Account authorization currently supports account paths inside the selected drive or document library. It does not make arbitrary sign-in-required share links downloadable.
rclone.authorization.manualDrivePreviewU: This manually entered ID is not in the current candidate list, so its root cannot be previewed. You may still submit it for validation by the following native configuration steps.
rclone.authorization.primaryVerified: The server confirmed this is the current signed-in account's OneDrive and its root is accessible.
rclone.authorization.noVerifiedPrimary: No accessible primary drive has been verified. Inspect candidates and preview them under Advanced. The first item is not selected automatically.
rclone.authorization.otherDrives: Advanced: other drives and document libraries
rclone.authorization.otherDrivesHint: All distinct drive IDs remain available. Matching names do not identify the same drive, and other candidates have not been checked individually. Preview reads only the selected drive's root.
rclone.authorization.previewHint: Reads only this candidate's root, without recursion, downloading, submitting or saving the choice.
rclone.authorization.emptyRoot: No previewable files or folders were listed.
rclone.authorization.previewHasMore: Up to 100 items are shown. The root contains more items.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_DRIVE_CHOICES_FAIL: Unable to check drive candidates. Retry, or inspect the original candidates under Advanced.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_DRIVE_PREVIEW_FAIL: Unable to preview this drive's root. Check access permissions or try again later.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_DRIVE_PRIMARY_UNVE: The account's primary drive was not verified in this configuration. Inspect candidates and preview their roots under Advanced.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_DRIVE_PRIMARY_NOT_: The account's primary drive is not in this question's candidates. Inspect the other drives under Advanced, or restart authorization.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_DRIVE_CANDIDATE_IN: This drive is not a candidate for the current question and cannot be previewed. Select again or refresh authorization status.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_DRIVE_METADATA_INV: The server received unusable drive information. Retry or restart authorization.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_DRIVE_METADATA_UNA: This drive's information or root is currently unavailable. Other candidates and saved accounts are unaffected. You can retry later.
rclone.authorization.question.config_sit: Enter a SharePoint site ID manually
rclone.authorization.answerDetails: View the selected option's original details
rclone.authorization.connection.onedrive: Access the signed-in account's OneDrive. This is the usual starting point for your personal, work, or school drive.
rclone.authorization.connection.sharepoi: Browse document libraries on the organization's main site with an authorized work or school account. It may not include every team site.
rclone.authorization.connection.url.desc: Use a known SharePoint team site address or name. Enter a site address, not a file-sharing link.
rclone.authorization.connection.search.d: Find SharePoint sites accessible to this account by name. Organization permissions may limit the search.
Use only when you know the exact drive ID, usually provided by an administrator or Microsoft Graph.
rclone.authorization.connection.siteid.d: Use only when you know the exact SharePoint site ID. A site ID is different from its web address.
rclone.authorization.connection.path.des: Use a known organization-relative site path, such as /teams/hr. This is not a local folder path.
rclone.authorization.driveIdentifierHint: The returned name is only an identifier. The number distinguishes this option; it does not mean access has been verified. Expand the original details to inspect it.
rclone.authorization.driveAccessHint: Submit this choice to check access. Expand the details to see the original name and ID.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_ACCE: Microsoft denied access to the selected drive or site. Check the account and application permissions.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_NOT_: The selected drive or site was not found. Check your selection or the ID you entered.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_REQU: Microsoft did not accept this drive or site request. Choose another option or check the ID you entered.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_AUTH: Microsoft did not accept the current authorization. Authorize again and retry.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_RATE: Microsoft is temporarily limiting requests. Please try again later.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_NETW: The server could not complete the network request needed for authorization configuration. Check the network and proxy, then retry.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_SERV: Microsoft is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_RECO: rclone could not recover to a configuration step that can continue. Please start authorization again.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_REMOTE_FAILED: rclone could not complete this request. Check the account configuration and network, then retry.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_CONFIGURATION_TIME: The rclone configuration request timed out. Check the network and proxy, then retry.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_BROWSER_AUTHORIZAT: Another authorization is using the server browser channel. Complete or cancel it before retrying.
Server authorization port 53682 is already in use. Finish the authorization using it, or use the advanced command-line method.
Unable to prepare browser authorization. Check rclone and network settings, or use the advanced command-line method.
The server authorization process ended. Prepare authorization again and sign in.
Browser authorization expired. Prepare it again and sign in.
The server restarted or the authorization process was lost. Prepare authorization again and sign in.
Browser authorization is not running. Prepare it again.
The authorization step changed. Refresh the status and follow the current step.
Paste the complete localhost:53682 callback URL from the address bar after sign-in, not the sign-in page URL.
The callback belongs to a different authorization. Use the URL returned by the current sign-in page.
This callback was already submitted. Refresh the authorization status; if it failed, prepare authorization again.
The server could not complete this authorization exchange. Prepare authorization again and sign in; do not resubmit the old URL.
Authorization did not return a valid result. Prepare it again or use the advanced command-line method.
rclone.problem.RCLONE_BROWSER_ORIGIN_REJ: This page origin cannot submit authorization. Open settings through the server’s normal address.
rclone.browser.exchanging: The server is completing authorization. Wait for the result or refresh the status; do not submit the callback again.
oauth.configuration.microsoftGraph.title: OneDrive / SharePoint authorization method
oauth.configuration.hint.manual: Use the default app to sign in, then paste the callback URL manually. No custom Microsoft app or local rclone installation is required. With a remote server or Docker, a localhost connection error after sign-in is expected.
oauth.configuration.hint.automatic: Use your own Microsoft Web app with a fixed HTTPS callback URL. After you sign in and approve access, the server receives the callback. Return to the original Bakabase tab to choose a drive or site.
oauth.configuration.tenant.common: common: work, school and personal accounts
oauth.configuration.callbackHint: Use a fixed HTTPS address that reaches this server, with the exact path {{path}} and no query or fragment. Register the identical redirect URI under the Microsoft app’s Web platform, not SPA.
oauth.configuration.secret.saved: A secret is stored on the server. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a new value to replace it. It is never returned or displayed.
oauth.configuration.secret.required: Automatic callbacks require the client secret value, not its ID. It is only submitted to the server and is never returned or displayed.
oauth.configuration.secret.clear: Explicitly clear the client secret stored on the server
oauth.configuration.newSessionHint: Saving applies only to new authorization sessions. It does not change connected accounts or the current session.
oauth.configuration.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save them before starting a new authorization.
oauth.configuration.ready: The saved automatic authorization configuration is complete. You can start authorization.
oauth.configuration.notReady: Saved authorization configuration is not ready
oauth.configuration.authorizationBlocked: Complete the automatic callback configuration, or explicitly switch to manual mode and save before authorizing. The mode will not change automatically.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_CONFIGURATION_LOAD_F: Unable to load authorization configuration. Refresh and try again.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_CONFIGURATION_SAVE_F: Unable to save authorization configuration. Check the fields and try again.
rclone.browser.automaticIntroduction: Sign in with your saved custom Microsoft app. Authorization opens the server’s result page and does not redirect back here. Return to this original tab to continue.
rclone.browser.automaticWaiting: Waiting for the server to receive the authorization callback. Return to this tab after sign-in; the drive or site selection will appear automatically.
oauth.configuration.secret.appChanged: Changing the app does not reuse the previous secret. Enter the new app’s client secret value; otherwise automatic authorization will not be ready.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_AUTHORIZATION_CANCEL: Authorization was cancelled. Start again when needed.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED: Microsoft authorization was not approved. Start again if you want to grant access.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_CALLBACK_ALREADY_USE: This authorization callback was already used. Refresh the status, or start again if authorization did not complete.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_CALLBACK_INVALID: The authorization callback is invalid. Start authorization again rather than resubmitting the old URL.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_CALLBACK_URL_INVALID: Enter a fixed HTTPS callback URL using the displayed path, without a query, fragment or user information.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_CLIENT_ID_INVALID: Enter a valid Microsoft application (client) ID.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_INVALI: The client secret value is invalid. Enter its value, not its ID.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_CONFIGURATION_INVALI: Authorization configuration is invalid. Check the app, tenant and callback URL.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_CONFIGURATION_NOT_RE: Automatic authorization is not ready. Complete the app and secret configuration, or explicitly switch to manual mode and save.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_MODE_INVALID: Choose manual callback or automatic HTTPS callback mode.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_AUTOMATIC_AUTHORIZAT: This session uses an automatic callback. Sign in with Microsoft to continue authorization.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_NATIVE_CONFIGURATION: The authorization result could not be applied to the account configuration. Please authorize again.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_PROVIDER_REGISTRATIO: The server OAuth provider configuration is invalid. Check the server configuration and retry.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED: This OAuth provider is not supported.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_ORIGIN_REJECTED: Start authorization configuration from the Bakabase configuration page on this server.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_SESSION_EXPIRED: The authorization session expired. Start authorization again.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_STATE_INVALID: The callback does not belong to a valid current authorization. Start again.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_STORAGE_PATH_INVALID: The server cannot safely access authorization storage. Check its data directory settings.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_TENANT_INVALID: The tenant must be common, organizations, consumers, or a valid tenant GUID.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_FAILE: The server could not complete the Microsoft authorization exchange. Check the app secret and network, then start again.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_TOKEN_RESPONSE_INVAL: Microsoft did not return a usable authorization result. Start authorization again.
oauth.problem.OAUTH_TOKEN_SCOPE_MISMATCH: The granted permissions do not match those required. Check the app configuration and authorize again.
oauth.configuration.manualReady: Manual callback is enabled. You can start authorization.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.originalUnavai: The shared files are visible, but PikPak returned no usable original-file download URL. This does not prove the link expired. A preview or transcoded video cannot replace the original.

Connect a PikPak account and install the official CLI in third-party settings, then use Diagnose and continue on the acquisition task. The system checks whether it can safely reuse the original task, save the share, and download its original files.

Diagnostics preserve existing files and history while checking the account, dependency, and original download state. Missing prerequisites or files requiring reconciliation remain on hold to prevent duplicate saving or downloading.
A download source must be chosen for each item.
Choose one mirror for each item; independent items can be selected separately. Then complete the account or dependency setup shown for that method.
Continuing runs the following steps with your choices. A source already bound to a task cannot be replaced here.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.directory.why: No server download directory has been selected.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.directory.acti: Select a writable download directory on the current server. A path on your browser computer may differ from the server path.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.directory.next: After confirmation, the workflow starts downloading and uses those files for later processing.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.account.why: The account required by this download method is not ready.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.account.action: Select or repair the account in the preparation area for this method, then refresh. An account already bound to a transfer or task cannot be switched.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.account.next: Account setup alone does not resume the run. Continue explicitly when ready. Authorization does not bypass sharing permissions or make every share downloadable.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.dependency.why: A tool required by the selected download method is not ready.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.dependency.act: Use the dependency link in the preparation area to install or repair that tool, then refresh.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.dependency.nex: Installing a dependency does not resume this run automatically. Use the action below once preparation is complete.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.downloadStoppe: The download is incomplete and its task needs attention.
Open the download task and resolve its source, permission, or network error. Avoid repeatedly retrying an unavailable source.
The action below can restart a failed download and access the remote service again. It is more than a status refresh.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.source.why: The current source is not ready for this step.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.source.action: Review the reason for each item and complete the setup required by that method. Return to acquisition to choose an alternative for an invalid source.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.source.next: Continue explicitly after fixing the issue. The workflow will retry this step.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.password.why: The current archive needs a valid extraction password.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.password.actio: Find the password for this archive in the publisher’s instructions. It is an inner archive password only when the prompt identifies a nested level.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.password.next: Submitting retries processing this archive without downloading the original again.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.plan.why: The processing instructions are incomplete, or an explicit step did not select a usable archive.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.plan.action: Choose how to handle the files: keep originals, allow bounded automatic detection, or edit exact steps from the publisher’s instructions. Obtain missing archive volumes first; do not guess renames or extensions.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.plan.next: Continuing retries processing this item. Keeping originals skips extraction; automatic detection remains bounded and cannot identify every disguised file.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.budget.why: Processing reached a limit or the server has insufficient free space.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.budget.action: Check the expected content size before adjusting individual limits, or free server space. Do not increase every limit blindly.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.budget.next: Submitting retries processing with the new limits while keeping the original download.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.repeated.why: Repeated content was detected during recursive processing.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.repeated.actio: Check for looping or duplicate archives and narrow the processing plan. An empty retry cannot resolve this state.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.repeated.next: Leave the run waiting while checking the input. This window does not bypass repeated-content detection.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.shared.why: Another run is processing the same files.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.shared.action: Wait for the related run to finish, then check for a reusable result.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.shared.next: Checking looks for the shared result again. The run stays waiting if it is still incomplete.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.processingUnkn: This processing step needs attention and has no safe automatic recovery action.
Review this workflow step and its input before proceeding.
Leave the run waiting until a recovery action is clear. Validation is not skipped automatically.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.publication.wh: Files have not been delivered successfully. The target may contain conflicting files or be unwritable.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.publication.ac: Choose a new writable delivery directory on the current server. Originals and processed files are preserved; conflicting targets are not overwritten by guesswork.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.publication.ne: Confirmation retries delivery by copying. The workflow proceeds only after delivery succeeds.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.cleanup.why: The safety conditions for cleaning up originals have not been met.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.cleanup.action: Verify the delivered results and wait for other runs using the originals. Do not continue cleanup if the originals must be kept.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.cleanup.next: After confirmation, recheck the conditions and quarantine or delete originals under the existing policy. Unmet conditions keep the run waiting; verification is never bypassed.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.boundSource: The source and account are bound to an existing operation and cannot be switched here.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.settingsNotFix: Public-share downloading requires the official PikPak CLI and account authorization. Once ready, use Diagnose and continue on the acquisition task to check safe recovery conditions.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.settingsHint: Use these when the prompt identifies a setup issue. Changing settings does not resume this run.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.transferEffect: This retries the Baidu transfer and may create files or folders in the cloud drive again. Verify the account and destination first.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.downloadRetryE: Continue the original download task, retaining existing files and checkpoints. Address the reported issue first to avoid another failure.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.continueEffect: Submitting retries this step and continues the workflow. Closing leaves it waiting.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.advancedRetry: Advanced: retry after fixing this source
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.confirmUnavail: I have confirmed this share now provides the original and agree to start the download again.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.confirmTransfe: I have verified the account and destination and agree to repeat the transfer.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.confirmDownloa: I have addressed the download failure and agree to continue the original task.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.notConfirmed: Not confirmed; the run will remain waiting.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.planChoice.ins: Use this when the publisher supplied exact instructions. Specify each step’s inputs, renames and extraction rules using actual filenames. The advanced editor is below.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.planChoice.aut: Try recognizing normal archives and identifiable disguised archives. Detection is bounded and does not guess renames or probe every file without limits.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.planChoice.kee: Keep the downloaded originals as this step’s result without extraction or renaming. Use this to save files for manual processing later.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.processingEffe: These changes apply only to the indicated item. Other items keep their original workflow configuration.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.publication.di: The delivery directory is on the current server. A new directory avoids overwrite conflicts.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.publicationEff: Delivery copies files without moving the originals. Verify the target server and directory.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.confirmCleanup: I have checked the delivered results and agree to recheck and clean up originals under the existing policy.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_OUTPUT_F: The download destination is not a safe regular file. Check the target directory and any existing item with the same name. Existing files have been preserved.
The local download file could not be read. Check the storage connection and file read permissions, then retry.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_EXISTING: Existing files could not be matched to the original remote checksums, or complete checksum metadata is unavailable. No download was restarted; review the files.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_LOCAL_FI: The local file changed during verification. Stop other programs from writing to it, then retry verification.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_DOWNLOAD: The downloaded content does not match Baidu’s file checksum and has not been delivered. The file has been preserved for inspection.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.storage.why: Processing storage is unavailable. Existing progress has been retained.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.storage.action: Reconnect the original working directory, then continue. Changing the default directory does not relocate this task.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.storage.next: Verify the existing files and resume the same checkpoint without downloading again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.GOFILE_CONTENT: GoFile explicitly reported that this share is missing or deleted.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_SHARE_DELETE: The shared files were deleted. Provide a new share or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_SHARE_NOT_FO: The provider confirms this share was not found. Check the address or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_SHARE_BLOCKE: The provider has blocked this shared content. Contact the owner or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_SHARE_VISIT_: The provider confirms this share was invalidated after too many visits. Ask the owner to share it again.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_SHARE_TEMPOR: The provider has temporarily made this share unavailable. Retry later; expiry is unconfirmed.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_SHARE_ACCESS: This share has access restrictions. Review its access requirements.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_SHARE_VISITO: This share reached its visitor limit. Ask the owner to share it again.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_SHARE_FROZEN: This share is frozen and must be reactivated by its owner.
cloudDownload.problemCode.RECOVERY_DOWNL: This download already has files, partial data, or recorded output. They are preserved; review them before continuing. Diagnosis will not restart it automatically.
cloudDownload.problemCode.RECOVERY_EXIST: Use Diagnose and continue to verify the existing files in full. This recovery never restarts a download or transfer.
Existing files did not pass full content verification or changed during the check. The original task and files are preserved; review them before continuing.
cloudDownload.problemCode.RECOVERY_DOWNL: The download request, source, or destination changed. Review the original download and current plan first.
cloudDownload.problemCode.RECOVERY_CHECK: The recovery check did not complete. The download is unchanged; diagnose again later.
cloudDownload.problemCode.RECOVERY_STORA: The original download storage is unavailable. Restore access and diagnose again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.RECOVERY_DOWNL: The original download outcome is not confirmed. Review its record and retained files.
cloudDownload.problemCode.RECOVERY_TRANS: This task has an existing transfer record. Review its outcome to avoid repeating the transfer.
pikpakCli.account.title: PikPak official authorization
pikpakCli.account.description: Shared files are saved to your PikPak account before downloading the originals. Confirmed save receipts are reused; Diagnose and continue checks whether an existing task can resume safely.
pikpakCli.account.permissions: Review and approve account and file read/write (files:write) permissions on the official page. The official account permission group covers your profile and account settings; the current CLI requires it for its post-login profile check, and Bakabase uses it to identify the account. File read/write access enables saving and downloading shares. Additional manage or permanent deletion (purge) permissions are not required.
pikpakCli.account.disconnectHint: Disconnecting removes authorization stored by Bakabase. Future tasks will require authorization again; cloud and local files are retained. To revoke the application permission at PikPak, manage connected apps in PikPak account and security settings.
pikpakCli.account.quotaHint: Free accounts can download, subject to available storage for saving shares and connected-app transfer quotas for the official CLI. Storage and quota problems are reported separately from expired shares.
pikpakCli.authorization.title: Browser authorization
pikpakCli.authorization.instructions: Open the PikPak authorization page, check the code below, then confirm the account and permissions. Use your current device; the Docker host does not need a browser or CLI installation.
pikpakCli.authorization.waiting: Waiting for authorization in PikPak. This panel updates automatically when it is complete.
pikpakCli.authorization.pollingPaused: Automatic checks are paused. Resolve the message above, then select Check authorization to continue without starting a new authorization.
pikpakCli.authorization.status.authorize: Authorization complete. Return to the acquisition task and use Diagnose and continue.
pikpakCli.authorization.status.expired: This authorization request expired. Connect again.
pikpakCli.authorization.status.failed: Authorization did not complete. Check the message and retry.
cloudDownload.source.mega.description: MEGAcmd downloads public MEGA files and folders directly without login or import. Keep the decryption key in the link. Transfer quota limits require waiting and do not mean the share has expired.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_ACCOUNT: Connect a PikPak account in third-party settings, then use Diagnose and continue. The share will be saved to that account before downloading the original files.

This authorization lacks the account permission required by the official CLI after login. Connect again, then review and approve account and file read/write (files:write) permissions on the official page.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_CLI_REQ: The PikPak operation did not complete. Check the network and dependency status, then retry.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_AUTHORI: PikPak authorization did not complete. Connect again and confirm on the official page.
PikPak authorization has not finished. The current session is preserved; complete authorization on the official page, then check again.
This PikPak authorization was denied. To connect the account, start authorization again and confirm on the official page.
This PikPak authorization expired. Start authorization again.
Waiting for you to complete authorization on the official PikPak page.
PikPak requires less frequent checks. Wait briefly before checking authorization again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_DEPENDENC: Prepare MEGAcmd in dependency management, then use Diagnose and continue.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_PROFILE_C: An existing MEGAcmd profile cannot be safely adopted. Preserve it and use an isolated Bakabase runtime.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_SERVER_RE: The MEGAcmd background process state is uncertain. Check the process and existing transfers first; files and records are retained.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_ISOLATED_: This integration currently requires an isolated MEGAcmd runtime managed by Bakabase on Linux. Discovering the tool on another operating system does not yet enable automatic downloading.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_PUBLIC_AC: Public MEGA shares download directly without an account. Use the public-share method with the full link and decryption key.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_SHARE_INV: The MEGA share link is incomplete or unsupported. Check the full link and its decryption key.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_REQUEST_I: The MEGA download request is incomplete. Check the source and output directory.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_OPERATION: The original MEGA request changed. Reconcile the source and saved operation record before continuing to avoid duplicate downloads.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_DOWNLOAD_: This MEGA download has existing files or an incomplete execution record. Everything is retained for reconciliation to avoid creating duplicate files.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_SERVER_UN: The MEGAcmd background service is unavailable. Check the dependency and service, then diagnose again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_EMPTY_RES: MEGAcmd did not return deliverable files. Check the share contents and download record.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_TRANSFER_: The current MEGA transfer quota is exhausted. Wait for it to reset, then diagnose again. This does not mean the share is expired.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_DECRYPTIO: MEGA decryption or integrity verification failed. Check the decryption key in the share link. Existing files are retained.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_SHARE_UNA: MEGA cannot currently access this share; expiry is not confirmed. Check the full link and access conditions.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_ACCESS_RE: This MEGA share needs additional access permissions or verification. Check its access conditions on the official page.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_NETWORK_E: A network error occurred while connecting to MEGA. Check this source’s network configuration, then diagnose again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_DOWNLOAD_: The MEGAcmd download did not complete. Check the execution record; existing files and history are retained.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_OUTPUT_IN: The MEGA output did not pass validation and has not been delivered. Check existing files and the output directory.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_ACCOUNT: The PikPak account or authorization changed. Reconcile the original account binding and save receipt before continuing to avoid duplicate saves.
The PikPak account authorization could not be verified. Authorize again in third-party settings.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_AUTHORI: This authorization session ended or is unavailable. Connect the PikPak account again.
PikPak returned incomplete authorization information. Connect again; the incomplete result was not used.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_CLI_OUT: The PikPak CLI response exceeded the safe read limit. Inspect the execution record before continuing.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_CLI_RES: The PikPak CLI response could not be recognized. Check the tool version, then diagnose again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_CLI_STA: PikPak CLI could not start. Check its installation in dependency management.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_DOWNLOA: The PikPak download is incomplete. Existing files and execution records are retained for reconciliation.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_EMPTY_S: No original files could be confirmed in this PikPak share. Check its contents or the selected subfolder.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_LOCAL_C: The downloaded PikPak files differ from the saved receipt. Everything is retained for reconciliation.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_LOCAL_P: The PikPak output path did not pass validation. Check the output directory and file names.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_NETWORK: A network error occurred while connecting to PikPak. Check the network mode and proxy, then diagnose again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_OPERATI: The current PikPak request differs from the saved operation. Reconcile the source, account and output path to avoid duplicate operations.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_PARTIAL: This PikPak download has partial files or an uncertain result. Reconcile them first; downloading will not automatically restart.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_PERMISS: PikPak authorization lacks required permissions. Connect again and review them on the official page: account for the CLI's post-login account check, and file read/write (files:write) for saving shares and downloading originals.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_REMOTE_: The saved PikPak cloud files differ from the original record. Reconcile them before continuing.
The PikPak cloud file listing could not be fully verified. Check the cloud contents, then diagnose again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_RESTORE: The PikPak save operation is not confirmed complete. It will not be repeated. Use Diagnose and continue later to check the result.
The previous PikPak save result is uncertain. Reconcile the cloud folder and save record to avoid duplicate saves.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_SELECTE: The selected file or subfolder could not be confirmed within this PikPak share. Check the complete share URL.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_SHARE_C: The PikPak share differs from its original manifest. Reconcile the changes first; added or replaced files will not be downloaded automatically.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_SHARE_E: PikPak explicitly reported that the share expired, was deleted or does not exist. Provide a valid replacement link or choose another source.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_SHARE_M: The PikPak share manifest could not be fully verified. Check the share contents, then diagnose again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_SHARE_U: PikPak cannot currently access this share; expiry is not confirmed. Check the link and access conditions.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_SOURCE_: The PikPak share URL is incomplete or unsupported. Enter the complete public-share link.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_STATE_I: The PikPak operation record is incomplete. Existing files and history are retained; reconcile the result first.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_STORAGE: PikPak has insufficient cloud storage to save the share. Free space in the official client, then diagnose again. This does not mean the share is expired.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_TRANSFE: The current PikPak transfer quota or request limit is exhausted. Check the account and connected-app quotas, then diagnose again when available. This does not mean the share is expired.
cloudDownload.problemCode.PIKPAK_ACCOUNT: The PikPak account is in use. Wait for its current operation to finish before changing authorization or disconnecting.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MEGA_PROXY_UNS: MEGAcmd supports compatible HTTP/HTTPS proxies only and cannot safely pass proxy credentials containing quotes, backslashes or control characters. Choose another proxy or a direct connection.
cloudDownload.problemCode.CLOUD_STORAGE_: Cloud storage is insufficient. Free space in the official client, then diagnose and continue. Existing transfers are checked first; an uncertain result needs review. This does not mean the share expired.
cloudDownload.source.terabox.description: TeraBox CLI accesses public shares. Its download integration is designed to save original files or folders directly, without importing them into your drive. See the integration status and limitations above.
terabox.account.title: TeraBox account
terabox.account.description: Connect your account on the official authorization page to access shares and read file information. Account authorization and download integration availability are shown separately.
terabox.account.permissions: Sign in and approve access on TeraBox. Paste only the authorization code here; the server stores account tokens. You do not need to provide your password.
terabox.account.disconnectHint: Disconnecting removes the saved TeraBox authorization from the server. Future downloads will need a new connection. Existing local files and task history are preserved.
terabox.authorization.title: Browser authorization
terabox.authorization.instructions: Open the official TeraBox authorization page and confirm the account and permissions. Copy the authorization code shown at the end, then return here to paste and submit it.
terabox.authorization.codeHint: Paste the one-time code from the official authorization page. Do not enter a password, cookie, or share access code.
terabox.authorization.noCallback: Use your current browser. No callback to the Docker host’s localhost or CLI installation on the host is needed.
terabox.authorization.refreshRequired: The result is not confirmed. Refresh authorization status before continuing so a used code is not submitted again.
terabox.authorization.status.authorized: Account authorization is complete. Downloading still depends on the integration availability shown here.
terabox.authorization.status.failed: Authorization did not finish. Review the message before connecting again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_REQUES: The TeraBox request did not complete. Refresh the status before retrying.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_AUTHOR: TeraBox authorization did not finish. Refresh authorization status.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_ACCOUN: Connect your TeraBox account in third-party settings first.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_ACCESS: Check the TeraBox share access code before retrying.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_ACCOUN: TeraBox account authorization changed. Review the download plan again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_BROWSE: Manage TeraBox authorization from the current Bakabase interface.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_CLI_DE: Install or repair the TeraBox CLI dependency.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_CLI_OU: TeraBox CLI returned more metadata than the supported limit. Check the share size or tool version.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_CLI_RE: The TeraBox CLI request did not complete. Check the execution record before continuing.
TeraBox CLI returned an unrecognized response. Check the tool version.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_CLI_ST: Could not start TeraBox CLI. Check its installation and execution permissions.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_LOCAL_: The TeraBox download or configuration path is not valid. Check the path and permissions.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_NETWOR: TeraBox is temporarily unreachable. Check the network and its proxy settings.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_PERMIS: The current TeraBox account cannot perform this operation. Check account authorization and share permissions.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_SHARE_: The TeraBox share is currently inaccessible. Open the original link to check whether it is still valid.
Enter a complete TeraBox HTTPS share link.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_SIGNAT: The TeraBox download link signature expired. Check the source again before continuing.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_STATE_: The saved TeraBox execution state could not be verified. Preserve existing files and inspect the record.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_MANIFE: The TeraBox share file list is incomplete. The full download scope cannot be confirmed yet.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_DOWNLO: This TeraBox download has an execution state that needs review. Check the record and existing files to avoid a duplicate download.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_METADA: The TeraBox share file list is readable.
terabox.authorization.codeSubmitted: This code has already been submitted and will not be sent again. Refresh authorization status; if it remains incomplete, cancel this authorization and connect again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_ACCOUN: The TeraBox account reference is invalid. Refresh configuration and select it again.
A task is using this TeraBox account. Wait until it stops before changing authorization.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_AUTHOR: The code was submitted, but account credentials are not yet confirmed. Refresh authorization status.
This authorization was replaced or ended. Refresh authorization status.
The code format is invalid. Paste the complete authorization code from the official page.
This TeraBox authorization expired. Connect again.
This TeraBox authorization was not found. Refresh the status before connecting again.
The code may already have been used. Refresh authorization status before continuing; do not resubmit it.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_DOWNLO: The TeraBox download response could not be verified. Preserve existing files and inspect the record.
The downloaded file size differs from the TeraBox manifest. File completeness is not confirmed.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_EMPTY_: This TeraBox share returned no downloadable files. Check the original link and folder.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_MANIFE: The TeraBox share file list changed. Review the new content before continuing.
The TeraBox file list contains information that could not be verified. Check the share and tool version.
The TeraBox share file list exceeds the processing limit. Choose a smaller download scope.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_OPERAT: The TeraBox source or execution settings changed. Review the existing execution record.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_OUTPUT: The TeraBox destination is not empty. Inspect existing files to avoid duplicate downloads or overwrites.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_SHARE_: The TeraBox share file list is readable.
The TeraBox share changed. Check it again and confirm the download scope.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_SOURCE: The TeraBox source is not valid for this download method. Check the share link.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_DEPEND: Install or repair the TeraBox CLI dependency.
cloudDownload.problemCode.TERABOX_SHARE_: TeraBox confirmed that this share expired. Use another source or contact the owner.
TeraBox confirmed that this share was deleted. Use another source or contact the owner.
cloudDownload.teraboxIntegrationUnavaila: The TeraBox CLI download integration is still in development. OAuth authorization and share file listings can succeed, but a download API compatibility issue currently prevents downloads. A connected account does not mean downloading is ready, and this does not indicate an expired share. Choose another source, or download manually and continue processing.
cloudDownload.problemCode.DOWNLOAD_METHO: This download method is temporarily unavailable. Choose another source, or download manually and continue processing. This status is separate from account authorization and share validity.
cloudDownload.problemCode.LOCAL_STORAGE_: The download or processing storage has insufficient free space. Free space, then use Diagnose and continue to check and reuse the original download, retained files and checkpoints.
Local storage could not be read or written. Check free space, directory permissions and the original mount before continuing. This error alone does not establish a full disk.
The original download or processing directory denied access. Restore its permissions and continue the original task, retaining existing files and checkpoints.
The original download or processing storage is unavailable. Restore its original mount before continuing; do not replace it with an empty directory.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_OUTPUT_D: The original download directory could not be created or accessed. The old record lacks the OS cause. Check space, permissions and the mount; this alone does not establish an expired share or a full disk.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.localStorage.w: The original download directory encountered a local storage problem. The download task was retained.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.localStorage.a: Check space, permissions or the original mount as indicated. Use Diagnose and continue in the acquisition task list to check recovery conditions.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.localStorage.n: Continue the same download task and reuse verified files and checkpoints where possible, without another purchase or transfer.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.localStoragePr: File processing encountered a local storage problem. Existing processing records and files were retained.
Restore space, permissions or the original mount, then continue this step. Changing the default folder does not relocate this task.
Check retained files and continue the original processing step without creating another source download.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_DOWNLOAD: Partial files are present without a verifiable checkpoint. Files are preserved and will not be downloaded again automatically. Review the files and checkpoint before diagnosing again.
The checkpoint does not match the local files or original manifest. Files and records are preserved. Review them before diagnosing again; verification will not be bypassed.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_OUTPUT_U: The download directory contains files outside this download manifest. All files are preserved. Review the directory before diagnosing again to avoid overwriting other files.
cloudDownload.problemCode.BAIDU_LOCAL_PA: A local filename mapping conflicts with existing files. Files were preserved; inspect the download folder and use Diagnose and continue.
The local file path is too long to write safely. Choose a shorter download root and retry. Existing files were preserved.
The saved local filename mapping cannot be used safely. Check the download folder and mapping record. Existing files were preserved.
workflow.waitReason.FILE_CLEANUP_COVERAG: Originals retained; per-file processing evidence is incomplete
cloudDownload.problemCode.FILE_CLEANUP_C: Some source files lack complete retention or replacement evidence, so the originals were kept. Delivered files are unaffected; no new download is needed.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.cleanupCoverag: Some source files lack complete retention or replacement evidence, so the originals were kept. Delivered files are unaffected.
You can inspect and use the delivered files while retaining the originals. Historical records without evidence do not require downloading or processing the files again.
Retry only rechecks cleanup conditions. Incomplete evidence keeps the originals; it does not bypass verification or download the files again.
cloudDownload.problemCode.LOCAL_STORAGE_: Free space on the destination volume is below the reserve. After freeing space, resume the current step from the task details.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.storageReserve: The current destination volume does not meet the free-space reserve. Existing files and progress are retained.

Check the volume used by the actual download, processing or delivery directory. Free space, then use Diagnose and continue or resume the current step. You can also adjust the reserve in acquisition settings; changing a directory does not move existing files.
Checks space again and reuses existing files and checkpoints without another purchase, transfer or new download task.
cloudDownload.problemCode.FILE_DELIVERY_: Extraction completed, but all current outputs are still archives. Confirm them as the final files or add processing steps. Existing files are retained.
The reviewed files changed or their storage is unavailable. Check the original directory and files before continuing; no new download is started automatically.
The reviewed files or waiting state changed. Refresh and review the current files again.
cloudDownload.deliveryReview.keepArchive: Keep these archives as the final result
cloudDownload.deliveryReview.reload: Refresh the task to load the current file review before continuing.
cloudDownload.resumeGuide.archiveDeliver: Archives or unknown files still need review. Extensions alone cannot determine the next step. All files were retained.
Review the files below. Keep all current files if they are the intended result, or add processing instructions for them. Existing archive passwords will still be tried.
Processes only current files without another purchase, transfer or download. A confirmed single outer archive can continue within persisted limits; other results require review.
cloudDownload.problemCode.FILE_DELIVERY_: Choose to keep the current archives or provide valid processing instructions for the current files only. Refresh and review the selection; no new download was started.
cloudDownload.problemCode.LLM_DECISION_I: The model returned a processing plan that was not valid JSON.
cloudDownload.problemCode.LLM_DECISION_U: The model returned an unsupported processing status.
cloudDownload.problemCode.LLM_DECISION_I: The processing plan returned by the model failed validation.
cloudDownload.problemCode.LLM_ASSESSMENT: The model did not respond in time. No processing plan was received. Your files were kept; see the AI audit log for the call at this time.
The AI file analysis request failed.
cloudDownload.problemCode.ARCHIVE_FAMILY: The file list still contains a multipart archive. Confirm the volumes are the intended final files, or provide extraction instructions.
cloudDownload.problemCode.INCOMPLETE_FIL: The AI saw only part of the file list and could not confirm that everything was ready for delivery. Review the full file list.
cloudDownload.problemCode.MAX_LLM_ASSESS: This attempt reached its maximum number of file analysis rounds.
cloudDownload.problemCode.LLM_OUTPUT_TRU: The model reached its output limit before it finished the plan. Increase the file processor’s maximum tokens in AI settings and retry.
cloudDownload.problemCode.FILE_DELIVERY_: The purpose or remaining processing of some output files is unclear. All files were retained. Confirm them as the final result or add processing instructions.
cloudDownload.deliveryReview.keepCurrent: Keep all current files as the final result
cloudDownload.deliveryReview.automaticRu: Only a single confirmed outer archive with no other files continues automatically, up to 3 additional layers and 20 GiB expanded by default. Unknown files, multiple archives or reached limits are retained for review.
artifact.deliveryLayout.title: Delivery directory structure
artifact.deliveryLayout.acquisitionDefau: Delivery removes folders recorded as system wrappers and preserves the original package folders and files.
artifact.deliveryLayout.customPolicy: These settings use a previously customized folder layout.
artifact.deliveryLayout.legacy: Keep the existing structure. Opening these settings does not change an existing task.
artifact.deliveryLayout.removeGeneratedH: Only remove wrappers identified by Bakabase processing records, never by guessing from their names.
artifact.deliveryLayout.collapseSingleRo: Collapse a single author-created outer directory (one level)
artifact.deliveryLayout.collapseHint: Collapse one level only when all content is inside a single outer directory. Preserve the internal tree, companion files and empty directories; do not flatten recursively.
artifact.deliveryLayout.exampleHint: Example: the first layer has recorded system provenance. Preview an actual task artifact to see its own layout.
artifact.deliveryLayout.previewHint: This preview uses the recorded file manifest. It does not move, copy or delete files, or change settings or tasks. Execution validates the files again.
artifact.deliveryLayout.previewFailed: Unable to generate the preview. Retry; files and tasks are unchanged.
artifact.deliveryLayout.previewChanged: Relative paths change for {{changed}} of {{total}} files
artifact.deliveryLayout.previewUnchanged: The directory structure is unchanged under this policy.
artifact.deliveryLayout.previewTruncated: Only the first 100 mappings are shown; counts cover the full manifest.
artifact.deliveryLayout.previewStale: The policy changed. Generate the preview again.
artifact.deliveryLayout.workflowHint: These are the publication node defaults. Callers such as resource acquisition can override them through parameters.
artifact.deliveryLayout.callerHint: These acquisition task parameters override publication node defaults. Changing them does not move existing files.
artifact.deliveryLayout.revisionHint: Reorganize this task’s delivered files. Save the revision, then start it separately. After it finishes, acquisition settings determine whether to keep files that the new delivery fully replaces. Run history remains available.
artifact.deliveryLayout.revisionReason: Adjust delivery structure using the reviewed file manifest
artifact.deliveryLayout.reviewAll: Generate a preview for every part. Save when at least one path changes; execution still validates the original files and checks for destination conflicts.
artifact.deliveryLayout.revisionFailed: Could not save the new revision. Preview again and check the original task. This operation did not change its files.
artifact.deliveryLayout.changedSinceRevi: The file manifest or its directory mapping changed after review. Generate fresh previews before saving.
artifact.deliveryLayout.validatingFiles: Validating published files before saving the revision…
cloudDownload.baidu.concurrency.title: Baidu download concurrency
cloudDownload.baidu.membership.label: Membership
cloudDownload.baidu.membership.failed: Check failed; the last observation is retained
cloudDownload.baidu.concurrency.tasksHin: Tasks running at once for this account, up to 5; available space may reduce the active count.
cloudDownload.baidu.concurrency.connecti: Parallel connections for one file, from 1 to 20.
cloudDownload.baidu.concurrency.confirmS: I have confirmed this account is SVIP
cloudDownload.baidu.concurrency.membersh: Free and VIP accounts use one task and one connection. For SVIP, start with 2 tasks and 4 connections per file. Manual confirmation applies when detection is unavailable; a confirmed non-SVIP result still uses one connection.
cloudDownload.baidu.concurrency.storageH: Applies to newly started downloads. Running tasks keep their settings. Acquisition downloads still honor the acquisition free-space reserve, preserving files and checkpoints when capacity is insufficient.
cloudDownload.processing.adaptiveUserCon: Describe what you can tell about the current files, such as a split archive that must be renamed before extraction. The bounded assessment uses this as evidence and never deletes unknown files directly.
